goal: Allow Bitcoin Core users to send funds to BIP 352 silent payment addresses via standard wallet RPCs
Improves recipient privacy on-chain by dynamically deriving unique Taproot output scripts per transaction
agreement: Broad concept support across reviewers, but edge cases around wallet restores remain discussed
Verified compatibility against another implementation across hundreds of test transactions (fametrano)
Verified input key filtering and fee-bump logic across test cases (Yudis-bit)
Unaddressed objection: restoring a pre-send backup before fee bumping breaks recipient scanning (Yudis-bit)
Concept approval without stated reasons (rkrux, w0xlt, rustaceanrob, polespinasa, davidgumberg)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it brings major privacy improvements by letting users pay silent payment addresses directly
Adds dynamic output derivation and fee-bump metadata persistence across all main wallet sending RPCs
